lemmas.primary_translation: red light indicating sold-out tickets / full house

definitions.text: lykt som lyser rødt (ved inngangen til en sal) som tegn på at billettene til en forestilling eller konsert er utsolgt
definitions.translation: a lamp that shines red, at the entrance to a hall, as a sign that tickets for a performance or concert are sold out (lit. red light)

examples.no: forestillingen ble spilt 80 ganger for røde lykter
examples.en: the performance was staged 80 times to sold-out houses

definitions.text: sal, rom eller lignende med alle plasser opptatt
definitions.translation: a hall, room, or similar place with every seat occupied
